name: Northpass Tower
summary: Northpass Tower watches over the northern road to Quel'Thalas as a ruin. Shattered during the Third War, the old Lordaeron scout tower still looks toward the elven lands.

sections.title: Northern Sentinel
sections.body: Northpass Tower once guarded Lordaeron's road north into Quel'Thalas. During the Scourge invasion, the tower was reduced to a broken shell. From its high ground, it still overlooks the frontier between Stratholme's blighted outskirts and the distant elven lands.

sections.title: A Silent Watch
sections.body: No garrison mans Northpass Tower today. Its broken walls stand beside the road, now haunted by the Scourge. The ruin marks the watch Lordaeron once kept over the route to Quel'Thalas.

faq.q: What was Northpass Tower originally built for?
faq.answer: The Kingdom of Lordaeron built Northpass Tower as an observation post to watch the northern road toward Quel'Thalas.

faq.q: Why is Northpass Tower in ruins?
faq.answer: The Scourge destroyed Northpass Tower with Lordaeron's northern defenses during the Third War. Cracked masonry and scaffolding remain.

faq.q: Does anyone hold Northpass Tower now?
faq.answer: No one holds Northpass Tower now. The Scourge destroyed it with Lordaeron's northern defenses, leaving an empty ruin along the road north.

faq.q: Where does the road past Northpass Tower lead?
faq.answer: The road past Northpass Tower heads north toward the Thalassian border and the southern territory of Quel'Thalas.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you see one of Lordaeron's fallen bastions in Northpass Tower, a broken sentinel on the road to the elven lands.
As a member of the Horde, you see in ruins like Northpass Tower how thoroughly the Scourge broke the northern kingdoms' defenses.
